description: Run the full automated qualification gate (build + lint + JVM tests for both modules, confirm existing :app and python boundary tests still pass), build the experimental debug APK and compute its SHA-256, then write the honest report at docs/experiments/media-interlude-poc-report.md separating IMPLEMENTED vs AUTOMATED PASS vs PHYSICAL SONY/PRIME NOT YET TESTED, including the exact branch HEAD commit SHA, experimental package id + versionName, APK SHA-256, and a short operator protocol. Depends on FEAT-001/002/003.
steps: Run the automated qualification gate with Gradle 8.9 / JDK 17 / ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk: (1) `:app:assembleDebug` still green (regression anchor, :app untouched); (2) `:mediaexperiment:testDebugUnitTest` all pass; (3) `:mediaexperiment:lintDebug` green (fix any real lint errors in the experimental module only; do not suppress isolation-relevant warnings); (4) `:mediaexperiment:assembleDebug` produces the APK; (5) `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` still passes (existing boundary tests unaffected).
Locate the produced APK at mediaexperiment/build/outputs/apk/debug/mediaexperiment-debug.apk and compute its SHA-256 (sha256sum). Record the exact path and digest.

Capture the exact branch HEAD commit SHA (git rev-parse HEAD on experiment/scenevibe-media-interlude-poc-001) AFTER the final code commit so the report's HEAD matches the delivered state. Note: because the report commit itself changes HEAD, state the SHA of the commit that contains the built code and clearly note the report is committed on top; alternatively record the SHA in the report as 'HEAD at build time' and update if needed.

Create docs/experiments/ and write docs/experiments/media-interlude-poc-report.md. Structure it with clearly separated sections: (A) OVERVIEW — this is an experimental capability spike, NOT M9, NOT production; the three capability questions. (B) ISOLATION — distinct applicationId com.scenevibe.tvcompanionpoc.mediaexperiment, separate module, shares none of SharedPreferences/Installation ID/Cloud/pairing/cache/db/signing/BootReceiver/autostart; no Cloud/assignment/FinalTrack/PackageInstaller. (C) IMPLEMENTED — list exactly what was built (module, manifest with mediaPlayback FGS + FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK + SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, own NotificationListenerService, AudioFocusPort transient-may-duck, MediaControlPort pause/play via MediaController, OverlayVideoPort fullscreen TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY local mp4, LocalAudioPort, state machine, safe-resume guard, TV diagnostic UI with five actions). (D) AUTOMATED PASS — the exact commands run and their results: build success for both modules, lint result, the JVM test list (the nine required scenarios) with pass counts, python boundary result. Be explicit that these prove logic + packaging + static checks ONLY. (E) PHYSICAL SONY/PRIME NOT YET TESTED — explicitly state that real audio ducking while Prime plays, real Prime MediaSession pause/play confirmation, and the real fullscreen interlude over paused Prime are NOT verified here; no emulator/JVM claim is made about them; Sony is reserved for M5 and MUST NOT be used for this. (F) DELIVERABLES — exact branch name + HEAD SHA, package id com.scenevibe.tvcompanionpoc.mediaexperiment, versionName 0.1.0-media-interlude-poc, APK path + SHA-256. (G) OPERATOR PROTOCOL — a short step list for a human to later run on real hardware (install the experimental APK beside SceneVibe, grant Display-over-other-apps and Notification access to the EXPERIMENTAL app, open Prime and start playback, then SCAN MEDIA SESSION -> TEST AUDIO DUCK -> TEST PAUSE (observe confirmed PAUSED) -> TEST FULL INTERLUDE -> verify safe resume -> EMERGENCY RESTORE / STOP; record observed PlaybackState transitions). Use markdown links for any URLs; no em dashes.

Be honest in the report about exactly what build/lint/test actually ran in THIS sandbox versus what must run in CI/on-device. If any gate could not run, say so plainly and give the exact command to run it.

DOCUMENT THE KNOWN BOUNDARY-TEST DELTA (do NOT try to hide it or edit the M5 provenance baselines/tests to force a pass): adding the required isolated module forced the single mandatory one-line edit `include(":mediaexperiment")` in the repo's one tracked settings.gradle. The M5 release provenance guards (tests/test_m5_phase_b/c/d_boundary.py) pin settings.gradle byte-for-byte, so exactly 10 of their assertions now fail on this experimental branch — ALL of them the settings.gradle byte hash and nothing else. Everything those guards scan (app/src/, tests/, .github/, docs/ inventories and all frozen production/oracle bytes) is UNCHANGED; the mediaexperiment/ module is entirely outside their inventory scope. State in the report that: (a) this is the expected, unavoidable consequence of adding an installable isolated module on an experimental branch; (b) the M5 frozen baselines and the production :app bytes were deliberately NOT altered (altering an M5 release guard to force green would be worse than an honest documented delta); (c) the M5 physical qualification is unaffected because no :app/production/M5-scheduler/FinalTrack/Cloud byte changed. Record the exact count (10) and that they are solely the settings.gradle pin.

Commit the report and any final touch-ups (e.g. 'docs(poc): add media interlude capability spike report and operator protocol'). Record the final HEAD SHA in the summary back to the orchestrator. Do NOT push and do NOT open a PR.
acceptance_criteria: docs/experiments/media-interlude-poc-report.md exists and contains clearly separated IMPLEMENTED, AUTOMATED PASS, and PHYSICAL SONY/PRIME NOT YET TESTED sections.

The report records the exact branch name (experiment/scenevibe-media-interlude-poc-001), the HEAD commit SHA, the package id (com.scenevibe.tvcompanionpoc.mediaexperiment), the versionName (0.1.0-media-interlude-poc), the APK path, and the APK SHA-256.
The report makes NO claim of real ducking or real Prime pause from JVM/emulator and reserves Sony for M5.
The report includes a short operator protocol for later physical testing.
`:mediaexperiment:lintDebug` and `:mediaexperiment:assembleDebug` and `:mediaexperiment:testDebugUnitTest` and `:app:assembleDebug` are all green.

The report documents the known 10 python M5-boundary-guard failures as solely the settings.gradle module-include byte-pin delta on this experimental branch, with the M5 baselines and :app production bytes deliberately left untouched.
verification: Run the full gate (`:app:assembleDebug :mediaexperiment:testDebugUnitTest :mediaexperiment:lintDebug :mediaexperiment:assembleDebug` + `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`) and confirm all green.
Run `sha256sum mediaexperiment/build/outputs/apk/debug/mediaexperiment-debug.apk` and confirm the digest matches the value written in the report.

Read docs/experiments/media-interlude-poc-report.md and confirm the three required status sections, the branch HEAD SHA, package id, versionName, APK SHA-256, and operator protocol are all present and that no em dashes are used.
findings: Gate run locally with Gradle 8.14.5 (JDK 17, ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk); Gradle 8.9 is NOT installed in this sandbox, so there is a toolchain delta vs CI (CI uses 8.9) which is documented in the report. Gate result: :app:assembleDebug, :mediaexperiment:lintDebug, :mediaexperiment:assembleDebug all BUILD SUCCESSFUL; :mediaexperiment:testDebugUnitTest = 17 tests, 0 failures (9 InterludeStateMachineTest incl. the nine required scenarios + 8 SafeResumeGuardTest). APK at mediaexperiment/build/outputs/apk/debug/mediaexperiment-debug.apk (95445 bytes), SHA-256 48fd2e4ce41c8e92acd288bc3379b321d6dd55af0be3817d684837f27a306462 (debug keystore signed, informational/non-reproducible). python3 -m unittest discover -s tests = 118 tests, 14 FAILURES: 10 are solely the settings.gradle module-include byte pin (M4 phases b,c,d,e,f,g + m4-sony-corrective + M5 phases b,c,d), 4 are new docs-inventory assertions tripped by adding docs/experiments/media-interlude-poc-report.md itself (m4-sony-corrective test_retained_java_tests..., m5-phase-b test_no_unlisted_production_test_config_or_document_file, m5-phase-c test_no_unlisted_file_in_any_retained_scope, m5-phase-d test_exact_file_inventory). NOTE: briefing predicted 10 (settings.gradle only); actual final is 14 because docs/ is in the inventory scope and the report file is new. M4/M5 frozen baselines, boundary tests, and all :app/production bytes deliberately left untouched (verified git diff --stat app/ vs c9b0efd is empty). No file under app/ modified; only settings.gradle (one-line include from prior features) and the new report. Report built against code HEAD 75bb58d and committed on top. No physical/emulator claims made; Sony reserved for M5.
